Physical_Meaning_and_Assumptions: Direct sum of depth-integrated SSA membrane plug flow flux and SIA vertical shear creep column flux
Stress_Regime_Validity: INVALID: Violates non-linear Stokes momentum conservation; assumes linear superposition of stresses in non-linear Glen rheology (n=3)
Double_Counting_Evaluation: SEVERE DOUBLE-COUNTING: In transition zones, driving stress rho_i * g * H * grad(s) drives both SSA flow and SIA deformation simultaneously
Asymptotic_Behavior_Fast_Ice: Dominated by SSA: u_SSA >> u_SIA; SIA contribution is < 2% of flux, but spurious shear stress is artificially added
Asymptotic_Behavior_Slow_Divide: Dominated by SIA if SSA is artificially constrained: If beta_b -> inf, u_SSA -> 0, q_total -> q_SIA; however, in intermediate zones (u ~ 20 m/yr), flux is inflated by 30-50%
Scientific_Audit_Verdict: REJECTED AS NON-DEFENSIBLE: Not derived from any variational principle or consistent asymptotic expansion of Stokes equations
Recommended_Architecture_Action: FORMALLY REJECTED: Must NOT be used in Phase 5 2D continuum model.

Mathematical_Formulation: q_SSA = H_ice * u_SSA;  div(2 H nu (2 eps_dot + tr(eps_dot) I)) - beta_b u = rho_i g H grad(s)
Physical_Meaning_and_Assumptions: Membrane stress balance solved across entire domain; basal traction beta_b represents effective combined bed resistance and frozen bed stiffness
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid for fast sliding, streaming, ice shelves, and transition zones; well-conditioned elliptic PDE
Double_Counting_Evaluation: ZERO DOUBLE COUNTING: Driving stress is balanced exactly once by membrane divergence and basal drag
Asymptotic_Behavior_Fast_Ice: EXACT: Perfectly captures fast outlet flow, lateral shear margins, and shelf buttressing back-stress
Asymptotic_Behavior_Slow_Divide: Interior divides: High basal traction (C_bed >= 10^8) enforces slow plug creep (u < 2 m/yr). While vertical shear profile is neglected, dynamic mass flux from divides over 1996-2100 is < 3% of total loss
Scientific_Audit_Verdict: RECOMMENDED FOR PHASE 5: Mathematically rigorous, conservative, robust, and standard in Antarctic Peninsula outlet glacier studies
Recommended_Architecture_Action: ADOPT AS PRIMARY ARCHITECTURE: Pure 2D SSA across Domain A and extended shelves; avoids ad-hoc hybrid switching.

Mathematical_Formulation: q_hybrid = H_ice * ((1 - chi(u)) * u_SIA_bar + u_SSA) where chi(u) is smooth transition function
Physical_Meaning_and_Assumptions: Velocity-dependent blending function chi(u) smoothly transitions from SIA at ice divides to SSA in ice streams
Stress_Regime_Validity: Heuristic approximation: lacks formal mathematical derivation from Stokes, but prevents abrupt gradient discontinuities
Double_Counting_Evaluation: PARTIAL OVERLAP: Blending function reduces double-counting but remains empirically tuned without unique physical basis
Asymptotic_Behavior_Fast_Ice: Transitions to pure SSA as chi(u) -> 1 for u > 50 m/yr
Asymptotic_Behavior_Slow_Divide: Transitions to pure SIA as chi(u) -> 0 for u < 5 m/yr
Scientific_Audit_Verdict: CONDITIONALLY DEFECTIVE: Better than naive addition, but introduces arbitrary transition tuning parameters (u_trans, delta_u)
Recommended_Architecture_Action: REJECTED FOR INITIAL SOLVER: Avoid arbitrary empirical parameters; retain as secondary research option only if interior slope diffusion is required.

Mathematical_Formulation: Full 3D velocity field u(x,y,z) solving horizontal Stokes with hydrostatic vertical normal stress
Physical_Meaning_and_Assumptions: Rigorous asymptotic expansion of Stokes equations incorporating both vertical shear (du/dz) and horizontal membrane stresses (grad u)
Stress_Regime_Validity: Valid across ALL flow regimes from divides to shelves without empirical blending or threshold switching
Double_Counting_Evaluation: ZERO DOUBLE COUNTING: Derived rigorously from balance of linear momentum and Glen constitutive law
Asymptotic_Behavior_Fast_Ice: Exact asymptotic limit for ice shelves and fast streams (reproduces SSA)
Asymptotic_Behavior_Slow_Divide: Exact asymptotic limit for cold ice divides (reproduces SIA)
Scientific_Audit_Verdict: MATHEMATICALLY OPTIMAL BUT COMPUTATIONALLY EXPENSIVE: Requires 3D vertical discretization (10-20 layers), increasing DOFs from 1.73M to 17.3M-34.6M
Recommended_Architecture_Action: DEFERRED TO FUTURE 3D EXPANSION: Not required for decadal Peninsula projections dominated by marine outlet glaciers.
